steps.name: Color of Emotion (12)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arke] in “Pneuma” and report the quest to [Hayden] in “Aie Island.”

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You woke up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I have a lot of thoughts.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: How are you feeling now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. But Pneuma… .
(Centering around where Arche is standing, spirits in the sky, on the ground, and in the distance are moving vigorously as usual.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However, Hecate threatened Pneuma and Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm not sure what his intentions were, but now things are back to normal... . For now, I'm going to think it's okay.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Pneuma is a place that plays an important role, so I don't think he will do more work.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: As long as Elysia and Pneuma are connected... . ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it really a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. It's not a secret. I'll tell you. As the two places connected, Elysia and Pneuma became influenced by each other.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If Pneuma becomes dangerous, Elysia also becomes dangerous.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So Hecate will not be hasty in threatening Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why arche and pneuma... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: … I don't know much about it... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Since I only manage Pneuma, I do not understand the will of the ancient god Hecate... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's true that I don't understand. Understanding such a being is itself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There's something you need to know. Most gods are in a similar position to Hecate... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't both the Old Gods and the Twisted Love this world?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Although we have the same love for the world, our behavior toward life is very different. Not everyone is like Ceres, Gaia, or Iris.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: In the twilight years, the gods became angry as soon as they discovered life opposing them. It may be harsh, but those lives were extinguished.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: With God who was the master... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: From Hecate’s perspective, Adventurer, who is now Iris’s person, will be no different from then.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: So, you should not try to understand God with human thoughts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Even so, it’s a bit frustrating… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It looks like Hayden would like to meet Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on on Aie Island?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No, I guess I want to talk about the hourglass... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, the hourglass of emotions. There are now two left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feelings of desire for passion and love, feelings of hope and peace... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These are things I took out of Pneuma by mistake, so I'll look for them right away.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, don't make it too complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know what you mean. We'll solve it somehow.
(Arke nods his head as if he understands and sees Adventurer off.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I know Arche is worried, but...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I also care that Hecate created the fate of witches...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go to Hayden first.

steps.name: Color of emotions (13)
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] in “Aie Island” and report the quest to [Irfan] in “Elysia 2.”

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. Marie, you should say hello too.
(As Hayden talks to the doll in his arms, Marie slightly raises her head and waves her hand quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello Hayden. Hello, Marie. But Marie, you moved like nothing happened right now?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Ah… .
(Hayden covers Marie's eyes with his hand with an embarrassed expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hayden, hourglass… .
(Hayden looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Hayden?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: He didn't seem to be in a very good mood... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Hayden is a spirit, so we can talk about it. Because it’s Pneuma’s job… . that is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell briefly what happened at a place called Elysia.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: After listening to %s's story, I understand that Circe did as she pleased with me.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Power received from God... A witch using... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Do you know anything about Circe's whereabouts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I haven't found out anything since that happened.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: … ah!
(When Hayden looks surprised as if something occurred to him, Marie, who was in his arms, also raises her hand.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: A method occurred to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: For a while now, I've been feeling a strange feeling in theaters, including on islands.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I thought it might be an hourglass, so I searched for it with Glaucus and Scylla like we were picking hair, but we failed.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Only Adventurer can find it, but I thought I could still figure out where it is.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: If you bring Adventurer later, you can find it right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… . I can't just go and look for it, but is there a way?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Emotions are buried deep and not revealed. I need something that can touch those emotions.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: If you have that, an hourglass of emotions will come to mind. Please bring me the items I found during my ordeal in Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are two pieces of the ordeal... , pieces of joy and pieces of sadness… .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: No pieces, just bring me one large piece at a time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...How do I get the big one? I should ask Irfan in Elysia first... I have to go through another trial...)

steps.name: Color of emotions (14)
steps.objective:
1. Complete the general quests [Making the Joy of Trials] and [Making the Sorrows of Trials] to obtain <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials>.
2. Take <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials> and report them to [Hayden] on “Aie Island.”

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: He said he would never come again, but he came because he needed something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I thought I was going to bring something like desert sand... . Now, let's talk. The expression on his face shows that he doesn't like me, but who knows... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Maybe I'll give you the answer in your story... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Irrfan the story of the hourglass briefly.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: When it comes to Pneuma, I have to help.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Retrieve the pieces of sorrow and the pieces of joy from the trials you encountered during the Trials of the Black Moon and the Trials of the Earth.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then I will make you a big one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many can I get for you?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Get three of each. Because I can make it for you anytime.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Instead, let me know that you will bring me a piece of the Ordeal before entering it. Only then will the pieces of the trial appear before you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Is it difficult to understand?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's some kind of quest. If you go without informing me, the Trial Piece will not appear, so be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I think this explains it well... . What do you think, would you like to try it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I don't like it if it's an ordeal, but I can't help it... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: As soon as I collect the pieces and bring them back, I will replace them, so go straight to the place you need them.

steps.name: Color of emotions (15)
steps.objective: Defeat [Glaucus] at “Eugamon Theater” and obtain <Red Hourglass>. Then report the quest to [Hayden] on “Aie Island.”

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It's amazing to see something like this, a token of trials.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I dug the ground in advance, and I'm going to throw it in there and bury it.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Then, the emotions of joy and sadness over overcoming the ordeal melt and flow into the theater.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m a little doubtful, but should I give it a try?)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Now, throw it here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(Marie raises her hand and throws the joys and sorrows of the ordeal into the hole indicated.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay to do this... .
(Marie takes a shovel and fills the hole with dirt. After a while, the huge theater entrance in front of Hayden shakes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… ?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I think it's done now... . Go inside the theater. Now you can find the hourglass.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? By the way, Hayden… .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Marie has no intention of hiding anything now?
(Marie looks at Hayden in surprise and then falls down in place, pretending to be dead.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll just pretend not to notice.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Marie will be happy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… . Then I'll go look for the hourglass.
(While wandering around the Eugamon Theater, where various stages are set up, for a while, I see something glowing red in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that it? Oh, that's right. that's right… .
(The moment you hold the hourglass filled with red sand in your hand. Unknown emotions flow into %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels hot for some reason... . Is this a feeling of passion and love? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like you hang out with the theater owner, Glaucus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go now.

steps.name: Color of emotions (16)
steps.objective: Talk to [Hayden] in “Aie Island” and report the quest to [Adkina] in “Flaming Wheel.”

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: While %s was coming here, the sand inside the hourglass reacted to %s's power and disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… , then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Don't worry. The emotional sand naturally seeped into the spirits returning to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now there's only one thing left... .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: There's green left, right? Mir will know that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where Mir is?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: They say they go to see the ancient dragon often these days. Because of what you do, you are far away from where you are... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Adkina… .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The dragon’s name was Adkina, right? Are you at the Burning Wheel? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know. Hayden, see you later. I'll go and talk to Mir.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

steps.name: Color of emotions (17)
steps.objective: Talk to [Adkina] in the “Burning Wheel,” obtain <Joy of Trials> and <Sorrow of Trials> and report them to [Mir] in the “Twilight Cathedral.”

lines.text: (As you enter the burning wheel, a large dragon, Adkina, is standing in the distance. It seems like they are talking about who is nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s. It's been a while.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer, it’s been a while.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have been doing well.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was just chatting with Mir for a moment. So where did you come from and eat so much?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hey, Adkina. You may think that I only go around eating, but that’s not true! %s If you hear this, please misunderstand.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You mean it wasn't that?
Growling.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was still wondering when I would hear that sound. I don't know about anything else, but the gods must have blessed your stomach so it's already surpassed that of a dragon.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina! It's so easy to say something like that to a girl... . The stomach has awakened, transcended... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't deny the facts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this conversation because Mir is there?)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's right, though. Do you know that, Adkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I guess I came here after seeing something interesting.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: In a city called Glaston on the continent of Freios, there is a competition over eating. Residents pay an admission fee to see it.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's fascinating. Paying money to see something like that... . How about giving it a try sometime?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehe, shall we do it after retirement? Just kidding. How about going to see it together later on vacation?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is that so? Oh, by the way, I forgot. Io brought a lot of food… . You too, come with Mir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wonder if Adkina ate it and got angry... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm not angry. It just wasn't my taste. There are other things too, so don’t hesitate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I will eat well.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was so busy talking to Mir that I forgot to ask about you. I can't feel much of the outside energy here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah, I was already going to tell Adkina... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Mir too, right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, that's why I came to Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hurry up and tell me. I don't think it's normal, but... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's it... .
(Adkina's expression hardens as she listens to Mir and %s's story.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I think I remember now that I heard the name. A god who is the master of witches. Such a ridiculous thing could not happen... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The one I know... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: He has already touched the pneuma. And witches influenced by his power appear, and the gates of the demon world are about to be connected.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Daphne's movements seem a bit different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know either.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'd like to go out and help, but maintaining this place is harder than I thought. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina, don’t push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yeah, don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking into it, so I'll let you know as soon as I find out anything else.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If Gaia wakes up, this place will also be maintained... . Yeah, I get it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir, I heard from Hayden, do you know where the hourglass is?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah, yes. I know! It's the cathedral at dusk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come right away.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Just a moment, %s. Please listen to my story for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: As I was passing through Riftrasir, I felt a strange energy coming from the direction of the cathedral, so I went there… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: When I asked the spirits flying from Pneuma, they said it was an emotional hourglass. I even went inside the cathedral to see if I could find it, but I couldn't find it either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I brought it with me when I left Pneuma, so I have to find it.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So I need something. Please bring that to me just like you brought it to Hayden. What was that name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The joy and sorrow of trials... .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, I think that's correct. You can bring it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go get it and bring it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Adkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I hope nothing happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: %s, me! In the meantime, I'll be at the cathedral. They'll be hiding on the roofed side to avoid the demons, so come over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...It's a bit annoying to go to Elysia again, but I can't help it.)

steps.name: Color of emotions (18)
steps.objective: Defeat [Morgana] in the “Cathedral of Dusk” and obtain the <Green Hourglass>. Then report to [Leef] in “Riftrasir”.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, it's Adventurer! If the conversation continues here, Adventurer may be attacked by demons and have to use the Essence of Resurrection that he saved for later use.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So, I'll finish it quickly. One, two, three!! This is the end.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You can now find the remaining green hourglass in the cathedral. I'll let you go without saying anything, so just go straight to the last room and find the hourglass! Did you know?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: And you can give the items you find to the village chief here! Then I'm done! I'll leave now! I guess I have to listen to it one more time, right?
(At the end of a space full of light and a sacred feeling, there is an hourglass shining with green light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why didn't I notice when I came here before? It's something that catches your eye right away... .
(The moment he holds the green hourglass and is about to take it, various emotions flow into %s, just like when he got the red hourglass.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's warm... . They say it's a feeling of hope and peace... . It seems like everyone had the same wish for God... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's more because it's a cathedral.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go now… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why are you asking me to go to Director Leaf with this?

steps.name: Color of emotions (19)
steps.objective: Talk to [Rif] in “Riftrasir” and return to [Arke] in “Pneuma.”

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, maybe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't come here to consult with Director Leaf about making plans for my retirement... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, no way. Did you think I would say that now?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I was trying to ask Mir if he had brought the requested item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't know that... . Here.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's okay, hehe. I was going to tell a similar story.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: If you are a Riftrasir resident, think about it because there are various benefits that are recognized throughout the Freios continent.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: An opportunity that doesn’t come around every day! Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: By the way, this… .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's an hourglass, right? A green glowing hourglass... . Was there something like this in the cathedral?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Ah… . this… .
(Leaf looks at the hourglass with a hesitant expression.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's been so long I thought I wouldn't remember... . The feelings that person was trying to protect come to mind... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Where was this originally?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May I tell you... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's okay, I have a big mouth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Considering that the spirit asked you to bring it to him, the director must not be an ordinary person... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even %s is not an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then I'll tell you. When I came out of the spirit world, some of the emotions that followed turned into an hourglass and scattered everywhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have to find it and meet the spirit. Wait a minute, that means I have to give it to Director Leaf... .

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: There is such a story in our village. As the guardian spirit of the elf village lived for a long time, he ended up living like an ordinary elf... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You casually say things that sound like legends. Are you talking about yourself?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehehe. well?
(Leaf smiles awkwardly and holds the hourglass in his arms. After a while, the green sand inside starts to glow and flows out.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Goddess. Please lead this elf who is lacking... . I will work hard to ensure that the mistake is not repeated again... . Now go back… .
(With Leaf's words, the sparkling green sand rises into the sky, circles the village, and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Okay, that's it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you do it?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I am the village chief of Riftrasir. All you have to do is receive a blessing and be able to communicate with spirits.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I will keep the empty hourglass, no, I will leave it in the song of the stars. I asked Mir if I could keep it that way, and he said it was okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? I feel safe as long as it's in the song of the stars. They also said that it was okay for a spirit to deliver a message from God.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: %s, I'm going to go to town because I have some work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, warden.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: I'd like to talk a little more about business to %s, but I'm sorry I'm busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please talk about business next time. Wait, business? What does that mean... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He just walked away. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I've collected all the hourglasses, I have to tell Arche in Pneuma... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thanks to %s, the emotions in the hourglass have returned. The spirits are also full of energy again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. How are you feeling now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. After coming to Pneuma, my feeling of anxiety definitely decreased.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Still, it's a good idea to get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That should be it, right? Because you never know what will happen next... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Shall we bring Aerura back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I like that Aerura is soft.
(Arke reads %s's lonely expression and nods. After a while, several Aeruras who were roaming the Pneuma sky approach %s.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Aerura is here to be by your side, so get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think Arche will be uncomfortable if I fall asleep here... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe, don't worry about that. I'm going to be going around Pneuma and checking on the spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's okay to sleep soundly. When the time comes, Kairos and Kronos will come and wake you up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s just close our eyes for a moment without worrying about anything else….)
(I fall into such a deep sleep. Still waiting for the day when I will wake up a little refreshed...)
